title: 2021 AMC12A 9
statement: Which of the following is equivalent to \[ \begin{aligned} &(2 + 3)(2^2 + 3^2)(2^4 + 3^4) \\ &\quad {}\cdot (2^8 + 3^8)(2^{16} + 3^{16}) \\ &\quad {}\cdot (2^{32} + 3^{32})(2^{64} + 3^{64})? \end{aligned} \]

solutions.text:
Since \(3 - 2 = 1,\) multiplying the product by \(3 - 2\) does not change it. Then \[ (3-2)(3+2) = 3^2 - 2^2, \] and multiplying by the next factor \((3^2 + 2^2)\) gives \(3^4 - 2^4,\) and so on. Each step doubles the exponent.

After using all seven factors, the product telescopes to \(3^{128} - 2^{128}.\)

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Multiply the whole product by \(3 - 2 = 1\) to start a telescoping cascade
